items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: And Mahalia Jackson stayed at our house around 1958, ’59 and sang at our church on Sunday morning

ctx.x: Quite a change. And it just happened to be the home of the Newport Jazz Festival at the time and I used to ride around Freebody Park and listen to the music on my bicycle. I couldn’t find any money to get in so I would just listen. And Mahalia Jackson stayed at our house around 1958, ’59 and sang at our church on Sunday morning and it was wonderful. But it was in 1956 I started playing trumpet in the elementary school, fourth or sixth grade, one or the other, and that was my first instrument.
Some music teacher along the way said I need a tuba player?
